content.key_idea: Each MoE layer invokes the all-to-all (alltoallv) communication primitive twice, once to dispatch tokens to experts across GPUs and once to gather their outputs, making it a critical and frequent communication bottleneck.
content.reading_order: Left to right along the top row of alternating Dense and MoE layers, then down into one MoE layer to see the per-GPU gating, two alltoallv exchanges, compute, and sum stages.

summary: This background/motivation figure illustrates why all-to-all (alltoallv) communication is critical in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training. The top row shows a pipeline alternating Dense Layer and MoE Layer boxes. A zoomed-in view of one MoE Layer shows three parallel GPU rows (GPU 0-2), each running a Gating function, followed by a red-highlighted AlltoAllv exchange that dispatches tokens to the selected experts on other GPUs, a Compute stage running the expert feed-forward network, a second red AlltoAllv exchange that gathers the expert outputs back, and a final Sum stage, with 'Input from previous layer' and 'Output to next layer' labels marking the layer boundaries. The two red AlltoAllv arrows visually emphasize that every MoE layer invokes this communication primitive twice, motivating the paper's focus on scheduling it efficiently.
summary_zh: 该图说明 MoE 模型中 alltoallv 通信的关键性：顶部为稠密层与 MoE 层交替的流水线，下方放大展示单个 MoE 层内三块 GPU 并行执行门控、经两次红色标出的 alltoallv 通信（分发到专家、再汇总结果）与求和，凸显该通信原语每层调用两次。
